blocks.text: Data, data science ki bunyad hai. Data raw facts (kache haqaiq) aur values (qeematon) ka majmua hai jin se information (maloomat) banti hai. Data numbers, text, images (tasaveer), audio ya video ki shakal mein ho sakta hai. Har roz mukhtalif kaamon se data paida hota hai. Analysis se pehle data ko samajhna zaroori hai, kyunke har qism ke data ko alag tareeqe se sambhala jata hai. Data ko theek samajhne se sahi results milte hain, aur ghalat samajhne se ghaltiyan hoti hain. Sahi results ke liye data accurate (durust) aur reliable (qabil-e-bharosa) hona chahiye.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Data ki quality (miyar) aakhri results par bohat asar dalti hai. Kharab data ghalat nateejon tak le ja sakta hai.
